              "Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.",

          "definitionContract": {
            "id": "complete-a-commitment",
            "version": "1.0.0",
            "evaluator": "bounded-static-commitment/1",
            "title": "Complete a commitment",
            "responsibility": "Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.",
            "invariants": [
              "Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.",
              "Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.",
              "An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.",
              "Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.",
              "Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.",
              "Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.",
              "Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.",
              "Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.",
              "Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.",
              "A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.",
              "Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.",
              "Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion."
            ],
            "expressionLanguage": {
              "id": "typed-static-commitment-expressions/1",
              "literals": "Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.",
              "references": [
                "parameter",
                "choice",
                "scenario",
                "derived",
                "activity",
                "finance",
                "row (inside exists.test)"
              ],
              "operators": {
                "eq": "Two compatible scalars -> boolean",
                "ne": "Two compatible scalars -> boolean",
                "lt": "Two compatible numbers -> boolean",
                "lte": "Two compatible numbers -> boolean",
                "gt": "Two compatible numbers -> boolean",
                "gte": "Two compatible numbers -> boolean",
                "add": "At least two compatible numbers -> number",
                "sub": "Two compatible numbers -> number",
                "mul": "Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity",
                "and": "At least two booleans -> boolean",
                "or": "At least two booleans -> boolean",
                "not": "One boolean -> boolean",
                "in": "Scalar and compatible scalar-array -> boolean",
                "lookup": "Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid",
                "exists": "Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false",
                "interval-covered": "Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine",
                "worst-case": "Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid"
              }
            }
          },
